CITY WATCH: THE LANTERN FILES
ECHO — MELODIC MEDIEVAL MUSIC SHORTLIST v1.1
21 October 2026 — Europe/London

BRIEF
Mark requested a new selection following the Ultima Online reference: melodic town and night themes, harp, lute, flute/recorder and small ensembles.
Ultima Online is a mood/instrumentation reference. No Ultima melody, MIDI or recording is included.
These are six new selections compared with the previous v1.0 reel, by four creators. Earlier samples are retained as research.
Recommendations are inferred from creator descriptions/tags/instrumentation. Mark chooses by listening; no independent ear approval is claimed.

LISTEN
The sampler is 3 minutes 5 seconds: six 30-second excerpts separated by one second.
Separate MP3 excerpts are in samples/. Full publisher tracks are available through the source/download links below.

FIRST COMPARISON
Try U01 and U04 for the main town identity; U02 for patrol; U03 for a quieter interior; U05 for tavern musicians; U06 for evening.
Keep future use scene-specific, with space for silence. No track is an approved game binding.

REEL TIMESTAMPS
0:00 — U01 — Town Theme RPG — cynicmusic — Daytime town / Watch Square
0:31 — U02 — Medieval: The Bard's Tale — RandomMind — Everyday patrol / quieter streets
1:02 — U03 — Meadow Thoughts — Écrivain — Quiet interior / reflective moment
1:33 — U04 — Town Theme RPG — ComposerBeck — Gentle town / civic interior
2:04 — U05 — Medieval: Minstrel Dance — RandomMind — Tavern / local musicians
2:35 — U06 — Fantasy: Rising Moon — RandomMind — Evening / quiet night patrol

SOURCES AND CREDITS

U01 — Town Theme RPG — cynicmusic
Palette: Harps and recorders
Proposed use: Daytime town / Watch Square
Reason to compare: The closest instrumentation match in this source-based shortlist for a small, melodic town theme.
Listening question: Does it feel grounded enough for the Watch Square rather than an idyllic village?

RIGHTS NOTES
U01/U02/U03/U05/U06 are explicitly published as CC0. U04 is CC BY 4.0: preserve creator/title/source/licence and describe modifications.
U01 has older comments about CC BY and general catalogue contact requests; the current specific asset explicitly says Now CC0 and carries a CC0 licence badge. This does not license the entire cynicmusic catalogue.
U03 is titled Meadow Thoughts on its creator page. Any different embedded title in the untouched download is preserved in the technical manifest rather than silently rewritten as source evidence.
Source/licence statements were checked on 21 October 2026. Creator statements are not a separate audit of every underlying instrument/sample-library right.
No payment, subscription or purchase was made. Credits are included even where optional. No endorsement is implied.

ACTUAL CHECKS
Six complete source files downloaded, hashed and fully decoded; six excerpts and the reel fully decoded.
MP3 exports: 44.1 kHz stereo, 128 kbps; -22 LUFS processing target and -2 dBTP processing ceiling, short fades. Measured decoded peaks are recorded in the manifest.
The codec container adds small encoder padding to each exact 30-second excerpt.
Independent human ear, physical iPhone/Safari, loop seams, game integration and Mark acceptance remain open.
The pack is deliberately compact: review MP3s, credits and source records. It does not bundle full source tracks.

PROJECT STATUS
Research/listening delivery only. Selection and any later Buddy integration remain separate. B03 sound effects and reserves are retained.
SIGNED ECHO — Audio Director
